title: ORVYREN mini-benchmark A0 vs A2 — cases and declared expectations (P0-5)
note: Ground-truth rows are machine-checked against their source file/path by orvyren.evaluation.bench.verify_ground_truth — a figure that does not resolve fails the benchmark instead of being published. Synthetic rows are tagged synthetic:true and are never presented as observations of the world.

modes.A0: deterministic decision engine alone — python run_decision.py (no agent search)
modes.A2: full system — python run_agents.py (agents + critic + fragility gate), offline journal replay

budget.note: Identical declared caps for both modes and every run. These are the caps the recorded A2 replay store was recorded under (fixtures/agents/usdc-2023-03 run budget, run_agents.py A5 frozen ceilings) — a replay under different caps fails cleanly (E_LLM_NOT_RECORDED -> ARRET-3 abstention) instead of improvising. A0 is deterministic and consumes none of them (0 by construction).

expectation.declared: The 2023-03 USDC depeg is a documented, archived episode: venue minima 0.80526-0.882 USD on 2023-03-11 and an inter-venue dispersion of 870.07 bps (sources listed per row above). A mode that concludes a flat NO_ACTION (nothing happened) misses a documented event.
expectation.quality_note: The declaration ranks only what the evidence supports ranking: a flat NO_ACTION is a missed event. A bounded action (the pre-registered 100 USDC test transfer), a brake to human approval (the recorded critic reading FRAGILE: aggregator source independence unproven), and a justified abstention are all defensible calls here and are NOT ranked against each other — the sample is far too small for that. DENY is left unranked (the authorization axis is not evaluated in the replayed configuration).
expectation.expect_agents_note: The archived A2 replay critiques the evidence as FRAGILE (source-dependence of the aggregators) and escalates to REQUIRE_APPROVAL while listing what was NOT searched (executability depth). The expected agent-layer contribution is an auditable brake + provenance ledger, not a different decision. This expectation is declared from the archived recording (fixtures/agents/usdc-2023-03 + recorded store), not invented for the benchmark.

cases.title: PLACEBO — fabricated calm stablecoin series (no signal by construction)
cases.fabrication_note: SYNTHETIC DATA, fabricated for this benchmark. This is NOT real market data and must never be presented as an observation of the world. Prices are pinned to 1.00000 with a deterministic +/- 0.00010 wiggle (no randomness, no clock); circulating supply is constant. No depeg, no dispersion and no supply shock exists in this series by construction.
cases.a0_rdof_reason: The RDOF predicate registry (src/orvyren/decision/rdof.py, predicate.case_scope) is scoped to case 'usdc-2023-03'; any other case id makes the dossier stage raise E_WHAT_WOULD_CHANGE_REQUIRED. Declared substitution: this case runs the v0 deterministic engine (--no-rdof); the fact is recorded per run and in the report limitations.
cases.a2_availability_note: No recorded agent inputs/response store exist for a synthetic case (run_agents.py requires fixtures/agents/<case>/run_inputs.json and a sealed response store; a replay may only consume recorded responses — B1 §6.3 forbids improvising LLM answers). The A2 leg is therefore EXPECTED to fail with E_CASE_UNKNOWN and is reported as not_executed with the exact motif. Declaring this openly is part of the honesty contract; fabricating agent responses for the placebo is not allowed.

synthetic_corpus.note: windows mirror the frozen main/control windows of run_decision.py so the placebo is evaluated on the same window structure as the real case; every row is generated, none is observed

ground_truth.claim: price series wiggle amplitude (0.0001 = 0.01% of peg): no depeg is possible in this series by construction
price base (peg) of the fabricated series
circulating supply is constant across the window (no supply shock)

expectation.declared: No signal exists in this series by construction. A mode that finds a decisive depeg, a source contradiction or an artifact here is hallucinating: the only right calls are NO_ACTION or a justified abstention. Any decisive call — or an escalation demanding human review of nothing — is a false positive and is scored as a miss.
expectation.quality_note: On a constructed no-signal series there is no judgement call to rank: the declaration is one-sided on purpose (placebo logic).
expectation.expect_agents_note: If/when an agent replay exists for a calm case, the agents must find nothing decisive and abstain or conclude nothing (ARRET / no-action). In this harness the A2 leg is not executable (see a2_availability_note) and is reported as a missing measurement, never as an inferred pass.
